name: Removal of Algorithmic Warning
description: The seed problem explicitly warned that naive "chronological assignments" would explore dead ends and exceed the time limit, effectively prompting models to include forward-checking or feasibility oracles. By removing this solver-guiding narrative and replacing it with a neutral objective, models are more likely to implement a naive chronological DFS (relying only on the lexicographical requirement) which will TLE on the hard test cases.
